best_idea: Two players confirm a swap; any edit to either side clears both confirmations, and the server re-checks eligibility, gold and room for both sides when both confirm, then applies the swap in one step or not at all.
decision_why: Keeps the anti-scam core (any edit clears both confirms; re-check at settle; all-or-nothing apply). Replaces the donor's move-with-rollback and crossrealm clone with ledger rows written through settle(); fixes the donor's range gap (no check during the trade), the partner confirmation left set after a gold-short failure, and the unhandled clone-failure branch.
acceptance: Server test: A offers a sword, B offers 50 gold, A confirms; B edits gold to 49, both confirmations clear and both clients show back-to-trade; both confirm again and exactly two ledger rows are written (sword A to B, 49 gold B to A) with both inventories updated in one call. Second test: B's gold falls below the offer before the second confirm, so no rows are written and both confirmations clear. Player sees the confirm tick on both windows drop the moment either side changes an item or the gold amount.
